comment:
Quote: "There was little attrition over the course of the study: five children (three in the treatment
group, two in the control group), or 2.3% at the post-test; four children (two in the treatment
group, two in the control group), or 1.8% at the 3-month follow-up; and four children (two
in the treatment group, two in the control group), or 1.8% at the 6-month follow-up.
Analyses of the data revealed no differences between treated and control children who
missed the post-test and/or the follow-ups in terms of the pre-test dependent measures"
